turns.q: What do you do outside of work?
turns.answer:
A fair bit competes for my time. I'm big on street photography — I shoot with a Leica rangefinder and I'm forever wandering cities looking for that one decent frame. I collect photography books, I love to cook, I used to DJ, and I've travelled a good chunk of Asia. These days I'm based in Bordeaux[[bordeaux]] with my family, which keeps me grounded.

turns.q: What do you do outside of work?
turns.answer:
Photography's the big one — street photography especially, wandering cities with a Leica and hoping a good frame turns up (mostly it doesn't, which is half the appeal). I collect photography books, cook a lot, and I'm forever putting music on while I do any of it. I also love to travel, particularly to places with a bit of a reputation.

turns.q: What do you do outside of work?
turns.answer:
Photography's the big one — I shoot street photography with a Leica rangefinder, mostly around where I live in Bordeaux[[bordeaux]] but wherever I travel too. I collect photography books, cook a fair bit, and I've always got music on while I do any of it — I used to DJ, so that habit never left.

I'm also raising a family here in France[[france]], which fills most of the hours the camera doesn't.

turns.q: What do you do outside of work?
turns.answer:
A fair bit competes for my attention. I'm big into street photography — I shoot with a Leica rangefinder and I collect photography books, which is a slippery slope for the wallet. I also love cooking, and I nearly always have music on while I do either.

I live in Bordeaux these days after stints in Paris and Brighton, so travel and getting to know a new place is a constant too — I'm oddly drawn to cities with a bad reputation.

turns.q: What do you do outside of work?
turns.answer:
A few things keep me busy. Street photography's the big one — I roam cities with a Leica looking for those small human moments that mostly refuse to happen, which is half the fun. I also collect photography books, listen to a lot of music while I potter about, and I love to travel, especially to places with a bit of a bad reputation.

turns.answer:
A few things keep me busy. I'm a street photographer — I shoot with a Leica rangefinder and I'm forever chasing that one good frame that mostly never happens[[street-photo]]. I collect photography books, always have music on, and I love to travel, especially to places with a bit of a reputation.
